basedOn.note: User device confirms Test11 still returns six results and preserves the known-good search/UI behavior, but folder click reports that the directory ID was not captured. Review of the current File Management V8 establishes the missing field contract: normalized 115 directory objects use fileId as the directory ID together with isDirectory=true, not necessarily cid.

features: restore the exact pre-Test5 search source again and leave its working request contract unchanged
keep transparent capture of the already-working legacy request/client return values
fix directory identification for the actual normalized 115Api contract: isDirectory=true plus fileId means fileId is the folder ID
continue supporting raw WebAPI directory objects where fid is absent and cid is present
route the captured normalized folder fileId directly into 115FileManage without a second search request
preserve six-result search behavior, video playback and cleaned keyword summary

evidence.contract: File Management V8 reads fid=String(f.fileId), isDir=!!f.isDirectory, then uses that same fileId as cid when opening a directory. Test11 incorrectly treated fileId as a file-only fid and required a separate cid field.
evidence.deviceResult: User confirmed Test12 works; the normalized folder fileId is accepted as the folder cid and the previously failing search-folder navigation is closed.

validationTarget: ipx-641 and ipx-641-C open their corresponding directories
mp4 search results continue to play
